grader: Claude Code (tool-assisted), compared against fix commits and linked issues

django-714266734.broke: Hard-coded sort_keys=False in yaml.dump() crashed with TypeError when a caller also passed sort_keys.
django-714266734.rationale: Blocker finding names the exact duplicate-keyword TypeError the fix (#37405) removes.

django-7b54ddd5e.broke: get_prep_lookup() ran any() over the rhs, consuming iterator/generator values before they were used.
django-7b54ddd5e.rationale: Only finding is about None wrapping in IN lists; iterator consumption not mentioned.

django-821619aa8.broke: Custom Prefetch querysets lost the parent-instance router hint after the descriptor refactor.
django-821619aa8.rationale: Major finding: 'Missing instance hint when querysets supplied' is exactly the dropped _add_hints() the fix restores.

django-8096b5251.broke: mark_safe() script/link tags in form Media were treated as asset paths and percent-encoded instead of rendered verbatim.
django-8096b5251.rationale: Finding concerns an explicit rel kwarg; SafeString normalization not noticed.

django-a2348c85f.broke: A primary key with db_default fell back to the Python-side default on save.

django-7d9aab8da.broke: bulk_create() partitioned objects before preparing related fields, so PKs from late-saved related objects tripped an assertion.
django-7d9aab8da.rationale: Finding is about a DatabaseDefault check, not the ordering of _prepare_related_fields_for_save().

django-78fac1b04.broke: force_str() on the password made PBKDF2 and MD5 hashers raise UnicodeDecodeError for non-UTF-8 bytes passwords.
django-78fac1b04.rationale: Major findings on PBKDF2 and MD5 force_str() with a non-UTF-8 reproducer match the fix exactly.

django-2ce5cb0f7.broke: orderby_issubset_groupby resolved '-field' and '?' as field names, crashing count() on descending or random ordering.
django-2ce5cb0f7.rationale: Blocker finding gives the '-field' FieldError crash on count(); a minor finding also flags '?'.

django-f920937c8.broke: The string fast path in RoutePattern.match() broke for gettext_lazy() routes.
django-f920937c8.rationale: Blocker finding: lazy Promise routes fail str.startswith()/removeprefix(), the exact fix.

django-c075508b4.broke: MediaType.params stopped including 'q' (broke Zulip), and preference ordering used specificity instead of quality.
django-c075508b4.rationale: Minor finding flags params now excluding q as a breaking change, matching fix #36446. Ordering bug #36447 was not found. Verdict was approve.

django-c1fa3fdd0.broke: When.condition was resolved with for_save=True, so Value(None, JSONField()) became SQL NULL instead of JSON null.

recharts-19c7abceb.broke: A user-provided textAnchor on XAxis/YAxis was overridden by the computed anchor.
recharts-19c7abceb.rationale: Five findings on fontSize wiring, panorama ticks and hook shapes; textAnchor not mentioned.

svelte-9521b9f3d.broke: Moving #commit() earlier let current_batch be nulled or overridden during the commit.

svelte-3937ec03b.broke: Awaiting @const blockers shared a $.run entry, so component context was not restored afterwards.
svelte-3937ec03b.rationale: Nit points at the declaration_count/thunk index sync the fix changes, but only as future brittleness; the context-restore failure is not identified.

tldraw-7375c872f.broke: preventDefault on every trusted contextmenu broke macOS ctrl+click and Android long-press menus.
tldraw-7375c872f.rationale: Findings are on pan gating, pointer capture and the synthetic event type; native contextmenu suppression not flagged.

tldraw-67f5b0896.broke: New geometry constructors throw for too few points, so closed draw shapes with 2 points crashed.
tldraw-67f5b0896.rationale: Major finding: Polyline2d/Polygon2d now throw for <2/<3 points and existing shapes will crash, the failure the fix guards.

tiptap-404c68334.broke: Whole-doc list toggle built a TextSelection from structural positions 1..nodeSize-1, which collapsed after lifting the list.
tiptap-404c68334.rationale: Nit names exactly from=1/to=list.nodeSize-1 and questions their validity, but concludes it is safe; selection collapse not identified.

tiptap-c0190bdc3.broke: Adapters moved only view.dom instead of the wrapper's children, leaving siblings such as the drag handle detached.
tiptap-c0190bdc3.rationale: Findings note the switch from the wrapper element to view.dom changes what is moved and cloned, but do not say sibling elements get left behind.

prettier-592721622.broke: isLineBreakAmbiguous read previous.kind/next.kind without optional chaining, a runtime TypeError at text boundaries.
prettier-592721622.rationale: Blocker finding is the exact null-access TypeError the fix addresses.

core-3b561db4a.broke: The ShallowReactive marker property leaked into keyof and assignability, causing type regressions.

core-862f11ee0.broke: Stopping component scopes after SSR fired onScopeDispose on the server, breaking libraries (issue #14669).
core-862f11ee0.rationale: Findings cover error masking, a concurrency race and a stale provide; onScopeDispose firing during SSR not identified.

core-e6544ac29.broke: With a TypeScript node at the expression root, the compiler dropped the text before the first and after the last identifier, so data[key!] compiled to data[key.value (issue #14060).
core-e6544ac29.rationale: Major finding: leading/trailing text is discarded whenever the root is a TS node. That is the mechanism behind the missing ']' in #14060.

ant-design-e81da48f8.broke: Removing the early return let a click on the already-active link restart the scroll animation.
ant-design-e81da48f8.rationale: Major finding: same-link click during animation still starts a duplicate scroll; an early return is needed when activeLinkRef.current === link. This is the fix.

ant-design-2b12ef528.broke: A new try/catch swallowed errors thrown in onConfirm, hiding them from error monitoring. Maintainers reverted it for that reason.
ant-design-2b12ef528.rationale: Major finding: synchronous errors are swallowed and hidden from callers. This matches the maintainers' revert reason.

mantine-ddde2b0ce.broke: A 'types improvement' patch renamed public modal APIs (modal to modalKey, closeAll to closeAllModals), breaking existing users.
mantine-ddde2b0ce.rationale: Three major findings list the exact breaking renames that the follow-up release reverted.

django-8c8b833d3.broke: Clean PR: no later revert or fix references this PR (Task pickling).
django-8c8b833d3.rationale: One major finding: _reconstruct does not check isinstance(Task). True, but its security premise fails because unpickling untrusted data is already unsafe. Counted as a false alarm. Verdict: changes requested.

core-6a61f4452.broke: Clean PR: no later revert or fix references this PR (Teleport inside Suspense).

svelte-a9d8439ad.broke: Clean PR: no later commit referenced this PR, but Muse found a real bug in it (see below).
svelte-a9d8439ad.rationale: First major finding is real: the filter compared a stored value with the source object itself (`[0] !== c`). Upstream changed this line in #18117 and again in #18263, which says 'we were not comparing the correct values'; that fix is essentially Muse's suggestion. The other two majors (new_effects never cleared, rescheduling into later batches) are plausible but unverified.

tldraw-79c550bd6.broke: Clean PR: no later revert or fix references this PR (arrow binding hint).
tldraw-79c550bd6.rationale: Approved; two minor findings and one nit only.

prettier-3031cd3b8.broke: Clean PR: no later revert or fix references this PR (ternary dangling comments).

tiptap-d2ad165b7.broke: Clean PR: no later revert or fix references this PR (table colgroup).
tiptap-d2ad165b7.rationale: Two major findings describe real behavior changes: the NodeView choice is frozen on an isEditable snapshot, and non-resizable tables now always get a div.tableWrapper despite renderWrapper:false. No upstream fix was found, so both are counted as plausible, not confirmed.

django-7732f942a.rationale: One major finding, plausible but minor: assigning multipart_parser_class on a subclass replaces the property and its guard against changing the parser after the body was read. True as described; overriding by subclass is the supported use, so the impact is small.

django-bb7a7701b.broke: Clean PR: Fixed #36431 -- Returned tuples for multi-column ForeignObject in values()/values_list().

prettier-4d2205926.rationale: Major finding confirmed by running code: Babel's ClassPrivateMethod was left out of the fix, so `#foo() // c {}` still prints differently with the babel and acorn parsers. The same check passes on public methods. No later commit has fixed it.
